correctness.rationale: Definitions normalized to the actual Haar pushforward in Su--Tomar. The two torus circle symmetries make pure powers of a orthogonal to all monomials with s or p; bounded evaluation extends vanishings to closures. Exact norm squared is \(\binom{2k}{k}/4^k\) by Vandermonde. Summing its reciprocal gives \({}_2F_1\) and the independently checked beta integral; an elementary arcsine antiderivative and Taylor expansion give the fractional asymptotic with cancellation of the apparent \((1-t)^{-1}\). Sharpness is the reproducing property, with no finite numerical extrapolation. The standalone standard-library checker verifies finite arithmetic identities but is not used as a substitute for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The fibre \((s,p)=(0,0)\) is the canonical nilpotent-matrix central slice of this inhomogeneous pentablock, invariant under its circle actions, rather than an arbitrary cutoff. On this intrinsic slice the paper's otherwise abstract RKHS kernel acquires an exact two-point hypergeometric formula. The resulting \((1-r^2)^{-3/2}\) diagonal and sharp evaluation exponent 3/4 are quantitatively noninteger and contrast with the paper's integrated cubic blowup; they supply an exact interpolation/evaluation benchmark for this newly introduced function space. Nothing is asserted for other fibres.
